overloads.semanticRole: Selects and returns one of the value parameters; if criterion is Boolean it acts as a ternary (must pass exactly value1/value2), if criterion is an Integer it acts as a 0-based index into the full value list.

jointConstraints.rule: When criterion is Boolean, exactly two value parameters (value1, value2) are expected/used. When criterion is Integer, at least one value parameter is expected and criterion is a 0-based position into value1, value2, ... ; an out-of-range criterion yields a type-appropriate null value.

constraints: All value parameters must be of the same type; the command performs no type-consistency check itself.
value parameters cannot be pictures, pointers, BLOBs, or arrays.
Choose evaluates every value parameter before returning, even ones that are not selected -- side effects and errors in any value parameter always occur.
